title: Harmonic approximation with affine output (Simon 5.3.1–5.3.4)
statement: For every n ≥ 1 there is C > 0 such that for every ε' > 0 there is δ_h > 0 with the following property. Let R₀ > 0 and w : ℝⁿ → ℝ be Lipschitz with ∫_{B̆_{R₀}(0)} |Dw|² ≤ R₀ⁿ and |∫_{B̆_{R₀}(0)} Σ_i ∂_iw ∂_iζ| ≤ δ_hR₀ⁿG for every C¹ compactly supported ζ : ℝⁿ → ℝ with tsupport ζ ⊆ B̆_{R₀}(0) and every G ∈ ℝ with |Dζ(v)| ≤ G for all v (Dw = fderiv ℝ w, ∂_iw = Dw(e_i), Lebesgue integrals over the open ball). Then there are a ∈ ℝ and a continuous linear functional b on ℝⁿ with ‖b‖ ≤ C, |a| ≤ C(R₀^{−n}∫_{B̆_{R₀}(0)} w²)^{1/2} + C√ε' R₀, and ∫_{B̆_{θ'R₀}(0)} (w(v) − a − b(v))²dv ≤ C(ε'/θ'^{n+2} + θ'²)(θ'R₀)^{n+2} for every θ' ∈ (0, 1/4].
